title: Kaiju No. 8 Anime to End With Final Movie in 2027 – Watch First Look Teaser
content: Kaiju No. 8 is gearing up for its grand finale, and the anime has dropped the first look teaser for its new movie coming to theaters across Japan next year. Naoya Matsumoto’s Kaiju No. 8 has been one of Shueisha’s biggest breakout successes of the last few years.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Most Ambitious Seinen Anime Has Bad News for Season 3
content: Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen are among the greatest anime out there, partly thanks to how they were brought to life by MAPPA . The studio took over production of Attack on Titan starting with its final season, and despite fans’ doubts, the anime emerged as one of the best.
author: ComicBook

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Cour 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer Ahead of January 2027 Debut
content: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court has released a teaser trailer for its second cour, which will begin airing in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8 Final Movie Announced for 2027 as Anime Conclusion
content: Kaiju No. 8: The Movie will officially conclude with the series as a theatrical film set for release in 2027, bringing the anime series to its final chapter on the big screen. The movie will follow the first two seasons of the TV anime and serve as the conclusion to the entire adaptation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8 Anime's 'Conclusion Arc' Revealed as Film Opening in 2027
content: TOHO animation revealed on Saturday that the "conclusion arc" announced last December for the anime based on Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga will be a film that will open in 2027. TOHO animation also revealed a "super teaser visual" video for the announcement.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Confirms Release Date for Its Return After a Long Hiatus
content: Fans of Kei Urana’s grungy dystopian sci-fi shonen Gachiakuta have been anxiously waiting to hear any word from the creator or Weekly Shonen Magazine on when the series will be returning following a three month long hiatus after the release of Chapter 173 in August.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll U.K. Home Releases Schedule Update
content: In a press release, Crunchyroll added several UK home releases in December, including a Blu-ray Steelbook of the second season of The Apothecary Diaries on December 14. Crunchyroll 's full schedule is as follows: October 26 Sailor Moon (Season 1) Steelbook (Blu-ray), pictured right.

title: DJ, Voice Actress Eriko Nakamura Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content: Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest.
author: ANN

title: AFA Singapore Screens Asian Premiere of Bless TV Anime
content: The AFA Singapore convention announced on Thursday that it will screen the Asian premiere of the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga. The screening will take place at the convention's NEXT Stage on November 27.
author: ANN

title: QCinema Film Festival Screns Live-Action Look Back Film in the Philippines
content: The QCinema International Film Festival in Quezon City, Metro Manila announced on Friday that it will screen the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot as the closing film of the festival.
author: ANN
